source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Clearly state who, what, when, where, and why.
3. Record all immediate steps taken after the accident.
4. Describe injuries involved in the accident, if any.
5. Identify witnesses and their contact information.
6. Note the equipment involved in the incident.
7. Document any environmental factors that may have contributed to the accident.
8. Attach any photos or videos taken at the scene.
9. Include a sketch or diagram of the incident scene.
10. Provide detailed causes and contributing factors.
11. Document corrective actions taken or suggested for future prevention.
12. Record any official reports made to governmental agencies.
13. Attach any medical documentation or treatment records related to the incident.
14. Ensure the report is signed and dated by a responsible person.
15. Maintain a copy for internal records and review processes.
16. Securely store personal and sensitive information related to the incident.
